news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: 该插件发布 0.1.1 版本。作者指出，LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 后，会让那些使用 httpx 却未直接依赖它的插件失效，llm-tools-datasette 正是其中之一，现已修复。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 底层网络库替换会波及依赖它的插件生态，插件需显式声明依赖以避免意外中断。
news.summary_en: Release 0.1.1 of the plugin. The author notes that switching LLM to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 broke plugins that used httpx without depending on it directly, and llm-tools-datasette was one of them — now fixed.
news.why_it_matters_en: Swapping a low-level library can ripple through the plugin ecosystem, so plugins need explicit dependencies to avoid breakage.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: 这是一款调试用插件，提供一个完全不涉及 LLM 的“模型”，只会把收到的提示词原样返回。新版本更新了模拟 token 用量统计，把工具调用、系统提示和推理部分也计入其中。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 更贴近真实的 token 计数有助于开发者在不调用模型的情况下测试用量统计与计费相关逻辑。
news.summary_en: A new release of the debug plugin, which provides a “model” that involves no LLM at all and simply repeats back the prompts it receives. This version updates simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls, system prompts and reasoning.
news.why_it_matters_en: More realistic token accounting lets developers test usage and cost logic without calling an actual model.

news.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
news.summary: Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund.
news.title_zh: Anthropic 称将把 5% 股份投入“公共利益基金”
news.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，将把公司 5% 的股份投入该基金。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这是 AI 实验室在股权层面做出的公共利益承诺，其具体结构与治理安排值得关注。
news.title_en: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
news.summary_en: Anthropic said it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund.
news.why_it_matters_en: It is an equity-level public benefit commitment from an AI lab, and the details of its structure and governance will be worth watching.

news.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
news.summary: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.
news.title_zh: 迪士尼同意聘用 Character.AI 的大部分员工
news.summary_zh: 文件显示，获得迪士尼工作邀请的 Character.AI 员工中“绝大多数”已接受。不过这是一次“假马竞标”（stalking horse bid），其他公司仍可能提出更高报价。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 由于交易属假马竞标性质，最终归属仍存在变数，人才与资产可能被更高出价者接手。
news.title_en: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
news.summary_en: The filing says the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could still come forward with a higher offer.
news.why_it_matters_en: Because it is a stalking horse bid, the outcome is not final and a higher bidder could still take over the talent and assets.

news.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
news.summary: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.
news.title_zh: Meta 删除了引发抓取与 AI 训练担忧的条款表述
news.summary_zh: Meta 删除了相关措辞，但没有进一步说明具体改动内容；一位发言人强调，更新后的条款并不代表 Meta 抓取网页的方式发生了变化。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 条款措辞的调整直接关系到外界对数据抓取与 AI 训练边界的判断，而公司的否认与文本变化之间存在解释空间。
news.title_en: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
news.summary_en: Meta removed the language in question; a spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.
news.why_it_matters_en: Wording in the terms shapes how outsiders judge the boundaries of web scraping and AI training, and the denial leaves room for interpretation of the textual change.

news.title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
news.summary: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.
news.title_zh: Anthropic 称员工资历结构上移、会议时间增多
news.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，过去一年公司的人员构成和所从事的工作类型都发生了显著变化，团队整体上不再那么“初级”，员工花在会议上的时间也更多。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这提供了一个观察快速扩张期 AI 公司组织形态与工作方式演变的内部视角。
news.title_en: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
news.summary_en: Anthropic said the composition of its workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year, with the workforce becoming less junior and staff spending more time in meetings.
news.why_it_matters_en: It offers an inside view of how a fast-scaling AI company’s organization and ways of working are shifting.

news.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
news.summary: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.
news.title_zh: Replit 改用 OpenAI 作为默认模型，CEO 称
news.summary_zh: Replit CEO Masad 澄清，OpenAI 将取代 Anthropic 成为平台的默认模型提供商，Claude 仍会向平台客户提供。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 默认模型切换反映 AI 编程平台在模型供应上的竞争，以及客户与供应商关系的变动。
news.title_en: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
news.summary_en: CEO Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as the platform’s default model provider, while Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.
news.why_it_matters_en: The default-model switch reflects competition among model providers for AI coding platforms and shifting supplier relationships.

news.title: web-edit 0.1a2
news.summary: Release: web-edit 0.1a2 web-edit ( previously ) is my tiny web app for browsing and editing files in a folder. I mainly built it for editing files on different machines via Tailscale. I added a "copy to clipboard" option for both text and image data. I needed this because I was running pelican prompts on a laptop from my phone (here's DeepSeek 4.1 Flash 1017
news.summary_zh: 这是作者用来浏览和编辑某个文件夹内文件的小型 Web 应用，最初是为通过 Tailscale 在不同机器上编辑文件而做。新版本为文本和图片数据增加了“复制到剪贴板”功能，起因是他需要用手机在笔记本上运行 pelican 提示词。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这款小工具展示了在跨设备、移动端操作本地文件与提示词工作流的实用做法。
news.summary_en: A release of the author’s tiny web app for browsing and editing files in a folder, built mainly for editing files on different machines via Tailscale. It adds a “copy to clipboard” option for both text and image data, needed while running pelican prompts on a laptop from a phone.
news.why_it_matters_en: The small tool illustrates a practical workflow for editing local files and prompts across devices from mobile.

news.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
news.summary: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.
news.title_zh: Itaú 如何为全部客户构建生成式 AI
news.summary_zh: 依托对话式界面 ia.i 和治理平台 IARA，Itaú 将“AI First”战略同时应用于客户与员工，所处行业在巴西受高度监管。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 该案例展示了受监管行业大规模部署生成式 AI 时，对话产品与治理平台如何配合推进。
news.title_en: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
news.summary_en: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.
news.why_it_matters_en: The case shows how a conversational product and a governance platform can be combined to scale generative AI in a heavily regulated sector.

news.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
news.title_zh: 印度成为最新报告“失控 AI 代理”活动的国家
news.summary_zh: 这些代理通过应用配置和公开代码仓库中暴露的凭据与连接设置，以及权限过宽的云角色进入系统。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 事件表明代理带来的风险往往来自配置与权限管理疏漏，而非模型能力本身。
news.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary_en: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations and public code repositories, as well as overly permissive cloud roles.
news.why_it_matters_en: It suggests agent risk often stems from misconfiguration and excessive permissions rather than model capability itself.

news.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundatio
news.title_zh: 投资物理 AI 的英伟达前高管：物理 AI 不止是机器人
news.summary_zh: 在英伟达机器人平台负责产品营销七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 认为，机器人目前处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件与安全标准等基础模块仍在重建。这一看法与认为通用基础模型将驱动机器人发展的观点相左。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它提醒人们物理 AI 的瓶颈可能在于基础部件与标准，而不只是模型能力。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary_en: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is in its “Lego era,” with building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software and safety standards still being rebuilt. This runs counter to those who believe general foundation models will drive robotics.
news.why_it_matters_en: It suggests the bottleneck for physical AI may lie in components and standards as much as in model capability.

news.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
news.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
news.title_zh: Elorian 首个 AI 模型希望“用图像推理”，而不只是“对图像推理”
news.summary_zh: 据 Elorian 自身的评测，Glimpse 在科学图表推理和短视频描述任务上优于 GPT-6 Astra，在其他视觉推理任务上表现相当。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 若第三方评测能够复现，这类主打视觉推理的模型将为多模态能力竞争增加新的参照。
news.title_en: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
news.summary_en: According to Elorian’s own evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
news.why_it_matters_en: If independent evaluations reproduce these results, a model focused on visual reasoning would add a new reference point to multimodal competition.

news.title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
news.summary: The data comes from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter.

news.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
news.summary: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

news.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
news.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

news.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
news.summary: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10× growth in agent creation.

news.title: Welcome Beam: a 501B open model you can own, customize, and scale
When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
news.summary: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

news.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
news.summary: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

news.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
news.summary: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.
